text:
lee_sre: heads up — noticed invoice preview spikes for a few tenants after we enabled latency-based routing with fallback. Preview shows both primary and fallback model tokens counted.
jana_product: that was expected for traces but i thought metering deduped by request_id downstream. Is this only preview?
lee_sre: preview index ingests both route variants as separate rows. example: request r-9 had tokens_primary=820, tokens_fallback=810 -> preview sum 1630. final ledger shows only the actually served model counted (fallback) 810.
omar_runtime: ah yes. routing runtime writes events for both candidates: intent_event (attempt) and serve_event. We currently tag attempt with candidate_id but preview grouping treats both as usage rows.
sara_billing: billing joins on serve_event_id for ledger. Preview uses fingerprint||tenant||hour and doesn't distinguish attempt vs serve. So attempts get counted.
maya_ops: that's confusing for customers who see double. Quick mitigation: stop forwarding attempt events to nearline preview. But attempts are useful for routing analytics.
jana_product: we still want attempts in analytics. Could we add a metadata field `route_decision=attempt|served` and change preview to only include served by default, with an optional `include_attempts=true` param?
omar_runtime: yes we can add `route_phase` tag at emit time. Current attempt events already include candidate_id, but not explicit phase. Easy change.
sara_billing: also need to ensure we don't drop attempts from final reports used by SRE. So keep attempts to analytics pipeline, but nearline preview should get a normalized row that marks attempt rows as non-billable.
lee_sre: small snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T11:45:03Z routing.attempt req=r-9 tenant=t-88 model=bigA tokens=820 attempt_id=atp_77
2026-03-20T11:45:03Z routing.serve   req=r-9 tenant=t-88 model=smallB tokens=810 serve_id=sv_99
```
preview inserts both. ledger only consumes serve rows.
maya_ops: rollout plan idea: 1) add route_phase tag (attempt/serve) in runtime emit; 2) update preview ingestion to ignore attempt rows unless `include_attempts=true`; 3) add `preview_meta` field listing sources counted; 4) add console banner "Preview excludes routing attempts by default" and a toggler.
jana_product: for product UX, include a small side-by-side detail: preview_with_attempts vs preview_without_attempts for 48h window so customers can inspect routing cost impact. Helpful for users testing fallbacks.
omar_runtime: telemetry: emit metric routing_attempts_count and routing_attempt_tokens, and preview_attempts_ratio = attempt_tokens / preview_total_tokens. Alert if attempt_tokens > 15% for top tenants.
sara_billing: agree. Also update the invoicing contract doc: invoice computation will continue to use serve events only. Add a support FAQ explaining why preview may differ.
lee_sre: one more edge: retries (client retry or ingress retry) can produce multiple serve events for same req. Ledger dedupes by serve_id but preview may see duplicated serve rows if retries differ in fingerprint. We should also ensure preview dedupe includes request_id when present.
maya_ops: proposal: preview dedupe key = if request_id exists then request_id else fingerprint||tenant||hour. That keeps preview accurate for retries.
omar_runtime: minor note: some legacy clients don't set request_id. We'll keep fingerprint fallback. Also we can compute a short 64-bit request_id_hash to store in preview index instead of full uuid.
jana_product: testing plan: canary 10 tenants for 24h with include_attempts toggle off, monitor preview_attempts_ratio and any latency impacts on nearline ingestion.
sara_billing: support will add console toggle and API param `include_attempts=true|false`. Also add `preview_meta: {included_sources:["serve","attempts-suppressed"]}` in response.
metering-bot: [automated] Created BP-4622: "routing phase tagging + preview attempt suppression" assigned to omar_runtime, maya_ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/BP-4622 :spiral_calendar: 
maya_ops: owners: omar_runtime -> emit route_phase + request_id_hash, maya_ops -> preview ingest filter + feature flag, jana_product -> UI toggler + comparisons card, sara_billing -> support copy + invoice contract note, lee_sre -> monitor alerts and canary telemetry.
lee_sre: thanks all. This should stop customers seeing phantom token doubles when fallbacks trigger. :thumbsup:
